Class SystemB.VinfoStat

SystemB
@FieldOrder({"vst_dev","vst_mode","vst_nlink","vst_ino","vst_uid","vst_gid","vst_atime","vst_atimensec","vst_mtime","vst_mtimensec","vst_ctime","vst_ctimensec","vst_birthtime","vst_birthtimensec","vst_size","vst_blocks","vst_blksize","vst_flags","vst_gen","vst_rdev","vst_qspare"}) public static class SystemB.VinfoStat extends Structure
File status information.

Corresponds to struct vinfo_stat in <sys/proc_info.h>. A copy of stat64 with statically-sized fields.
